method: Playwright Chromium at 1440x1000; real File Cabinet, 5000 files in one folder, mocked read responses. ORVANE_GRID_BASELINE=1 enables the diagnostic test against the baseline checkout. Candidate uses the same fixture and viewport.
context: DOM/layout diagnostics, not foreground timing, frame-rate or heap measurements

visualComparison.note: Whole screenshot differences are confined to the view toggle focus/hover state.

limits: Windowing applies above 100 records and renders complete CSS grid rows plus overscan and an active rename row.
Application filtering and selection cover the full dataset; browser-native Find sees mounted text.
Open query-result budgets, Notes snapshot/persistence work and foreground 50-app profiling remain pending.
